cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small independent riverside cinema lobby with old film reels and an unlettered ticket stand — she dresses as a retro cinema usher for a themed evening; a modern canal-side bakery terrace at blue hour — she pauses to break a warm pull-apart bun into two portions; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — chest-deep in the water; a desert oasis at golden hour — sitting on the ground; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — standing; a city rooftop party under string lights — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — standing; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing close to a high shelf or line
